user.title: Set up Ticket System
user.description: Creates a local ticket system. Tickets are stored inside Home Assistant.

abort.single_instance_allowed: The ticket system is already set up. Only one instance is possible.

init.title: Notifications
init.description: Choose who is informed about tickets and whether critical tickets are spoken aloud.

data_description.tts_volume: 0 % = leave the volume unchanged; the previous level is restored after the announcement

priority.name: Priority
priority.description: Urgency: low, medium, high or critical.

notify.name: Send notifications

update.description: Updates one or more fields of an existing ticket.

ticket_id.description: ID of the ticket to update.

set_status.name: Set ticket status
set_status.description: Changes only the status of a ticket.

status.name: Status
status.description: New status: open, in_progress or closed.

ticket_id.name: Ticket ID
ticket_id.description: ID of the ticket to delete.

notify.name: Notify about ticket
notify.description: Sends an info or a reminder about an existing ticket.

ticket_id.name: Ticket ID
ticket_id.description: ID of the ticket the message is about.

message.name: Message
message.description: Custom text. Empty uses the generated text.

notify_service.name: Notify service
notify_service.description: Send only via this service, for example mobile_app_pixel.
